alignments.note: Perfect rendered by a passive frame are estranged; explicit subject noun stands separately.
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes its supplied the (rule 46).
Supplied the belongs to the noun (rule 15).
Verb with subject pronoun; astray completes the lexeme of תָּעָה (rule 44).

מִבֶּטֶן 'from the belly' recast as the clause as soon as they are born; no English word writes either morpheme's own lexeme, so the phrase is indivisible (rule 6), headed on the first source token as the deterministic anchor and on born as the lexical English anchor. Competing split: as soon as to the temporal מִן, they are born to the noun.
Construct participle rendered as the English participle speaking.
Rectum rendered as the verb's bare object lies; no of written.
